localChanges: A Caravan or Diplomat sent to a city by GoTo now stops next to it and asks what to do there, as moving it in by hand does, so a Caravan can help build a Wonder at the end of its journey (#357).
Meeting another civilization while on GoTo now opens talks with them, as moving the unit yourself does.

GoTo now goes around other civilizations' cities and units, so a Bomber sent home no longer stops short and runs out of fuel, and a unit whose way is blocked is handed back to you instead of still showing G (closes #357).
